stories.title: Crosetto scrive lettera a Kallas, 'serve potenziamento missione europea Aspides'

en.title: Crosetto writes letter to Kallas, 'European Aspides mission reinforcement needed'
en.summary: Italy's Defense Minister requests strengthening of the European Aspides mission in the Red Sea and states readiness to deploy a second frigate if required.

stories.title: Barilla to invest €100 million in the South, set up new pasta hub in Foggia

en.title: Barilla to invest €100 million in the South, set up new pasta hub in Foggia
en.summary: Barilla plans a 100 million euro investment in Southern Italy, establishing a new pasta production facility in Foggia that will serve as a strategic hub and create jobs.

stories.title: Macron prepara la Francia agli attacchi ibridi russi

en.title: Macron prepares France for Russian hybrid attacks
en.summary: France is developing a national plan against Russian hybrid threats including drones, sabotage, and cyberattacks, while the EU proposes an emergency security protocol.

stories.title: Mar Rosso, lettera di Crosetto a Kallas: servono sei navi Ue per lo Stretto, paghi l’Europa

en.title: Red Sea, Crosetto's letter to Kallas: six EU ships needed for the Strait, Europe should pay
en.summary: Italy's Defense Minister requests strengthening the Aspides mission in the Red Sea with six European vessels and demands that costs be shared by the European Union.

stories.title: Ostuni, pescatore di 70 anni muore colpito da un fulmine sugli scogli

en.title: Ostuni, 70-year-old fisherman dies struck by lightning on rocks
en.summary: A 70-year-old fisherman in Ostuni was killed by a lightning strike while on rocks. A companion present at the time remained unharmed.

stories.title: Mar Rosso, Crosetto scrive all’Ue: più navi per Aspides o fondi per sostenere le fregate italiane

en.title: Red Sea, Crosetto writes to EU: more ships for Aspides or funds to support Italian frigates
en.summary: Italy's defense minister requested urgent EU intervention regarding Red Sea operations, indicating Italy would deploy additional resources if costs and risks are shared among member states.

stories.title: Arabia Saudita, gli Houthi attaccano una base aerea: colpito Eurofighter italiano. Crosetto: “Nessun ferito”

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Houthis attack air base: Italian Eurofighter hit. Crosetto: 'No injuries'
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked a Saudi air base where Italian military personnel are deployed on the Inherent Resolve mission, damaging an Italian Eurofighter. Italy's defense minister confirmed no personnel were injured and no other equipment was damaged.

stories.title: Roberto Vannacci a Torino per un convegno, centro blindato per un presidio contro il generale

en.title: Roberto Vannacci in Turin for conference, city center secured due to protest against general
en.summary: Roberto Vannacci, leader of Futuro Nazionale, attended an assembly on security in Turin while protesters gathered outside, chanting and throwing eggs. Police implemented security measures in the city center.

stories.title: Vannacci a Torino, tensioni al presidio: uova contro le forze dell'ordine

en.title: Vannacci in Turin, tensions at protest: eggs thrown at police
en.summary: Protesters gathered outside a hotel hosting a security conference attended by a political figure, with some attempting to reach the venue while riot police maintained control of access points.

stories.title: Vannacci a Torino, presidio antifascista davanti all'hotel del convegno sulla sicurezza, «Non è gradito»

en.title: Vannacci in Turin, antifascist protest outside hotel hosting security conference, "Not welcome"
en.summary: Approximately fifty protesters gathered outside a hotel in Turin where a political leader was attending a conference on urban insecurity, expressing opposition to his presence.

stories.title: Torino: cori, striscioni e fumogeni al presidio contro Roberto Vannacci

en.title: Turin: chants, banners and flares at protest against Roberto Vannacci
en.summary: A demonstration occurred on Friday, September 18, against Roberto Vannacci during a security conference organized by a police union.

stories.title: Arabia, colpito un jet italiano in una base sotto attacco. A Bab el-Mandeb scortata una nostra nave

en.title: Arabia, Italian jet hit at base under attack. Our ship escorted at Bab el-Mandeb
en.summary: An Italian military jet was struck at a base during an attack, with no military personnel involved. An Italian frigate in the Aspides operation escorted an Italian merchant vessel through the strait.

stories.title: Nucleare, Edison punta al primo mini-reattore in Italia nel 2035

en.title: Nuclear, Edison aims for first mini-reactor in Italy by 2035
en.summary: Edison plans to build a series of ten mini-reactors across Europe worth tens of billions of euros, with the first facility to be constructed in Italy by 2035.

stories.title: Via al fondo Ligurcapital da 10 milioni per imprese e startup

en.title: Ligurcapital fund launches with 10 million for businesses and startups
en.summary: Ligurian startups and small to medium enterprises can apply from September 22 for equity and semi-equity funding ranging from 100,000 to 500,000 euros.

stories.title: Al via “Napoli città mondo” per promuovere la sua cultura e le sue imprese

en.title: Naples City World launches to promote its culture and enterprises
en.summary: A new cultural promotion program called Naples City World has been launched by Italy's Foreign Ministry to showcase the city's culture and business sector.

stories.title: Biometano, in cantiere 398 impianti per 1,3 miliardi di metri cubi

en.title: Biomethane: 398 plants under construction for 1.3 billion cubic meters
en.summary: A total of 398 biomethane plants have received government incentives through PNRR funding, with a combined capacity of 1.3 billion cubic meters.

stories.title: Leadership femminile: un tema di innovazione, qualità e competitività

en.title: Female leadership: a matter of innovation, quality and competitiveness
en.summary: The Lead Her Way 2026 initiative, sponsored by Range Rover, held its third event focusing on leadership, competitiveness, innovation and human capital.
